name: blue-bee
description: Blue Bee — commercial laundry & specialty-cleaning operating system for the GTA. Monorepo: customer/owner/driver mobile apps (React Native + Expo), web console + customer web (Next.js), and the API (NestJS modular monolith).

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('packages/shared/src')){console.log('[postinstall] workspace source absent (e.g. API Docker deps stage) -- skipping shared/api-client prebuild');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('npm run build --workspace @blue-bee/shared && npm run build --workspace @blue-bee/api-client',{stdio:'inherit'})"
